caption: The drawing depicts a small sculpted figure of a squirrel sitting on its haunches atop an oval base. The squirrel has grayish fur with shading that varies from light to darker gray, and there are areas with hints of brown and yellow, especially around the base and lower body. The squirrel's bushy tail curves upward behind its back with distinct darker lines indicating the tail's texture. Its ears are pointed and slightly tinged with a muted pinkish hue, as are the inner corners of its mouth. The eyes are prominent and carefully detailed in brown and black, giving the figure a lifelike expression. The squirrel is holding what appears to be a nut or an object in its front paws near its mouth. The background of the drawing is off-white, and there are no other objects in the image. Near the base of the sculpture, the artist has written the name “INEZ MC COMBS” in small, neat letters.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Squirrel
